title: Hip fracture: initial, subsequent or history
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's hip fracture at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Pain and inability to bear weight on right hip.

HPI
Pt is a 70 y/o female presenting with acute pain following a fall 2 days ago. Pt reports she landed on her side and was unable to stand. Pain is severe and localized to the right hip. Pt denies any previous history of trauma to this area.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 650mg every 6 hours PRN for pain.

Exam
Pt in chair, in significant distress. Right hip shows marked swelling and tenderness to palpation. Range of motion restricted due to pain. Neuro and vascular status intact distally.

Assessment
1. Hip fracture.
2. Closed fracture of the right femoral neck.

Plan
X-ray today confirms a closed fracture of the right femoral neck. Started on scheduled analgesics for pain management. Referred to orthopedic surgery for urgent evaluation and surgical intervention. Pt instructed to remain non-weight bearing.

Electronically signed
D. Kowalski, MD
05/14/2026
explanations: Closed fracture of the neck of the right femur, newly diagnosed, active treatment: 7th character A (HCC 402): S72.001A.

distractors.why: The fracture is newly diagnosed and under active treatment: 7th character A.
